geṇḍuka:
1geṇḍuka
m. [S. lex. id.], a ball (to play with); Abh 316 (~o kanduko); Ja IV 30,.25 (ath’ assa putto … ~ena kīḷi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr bheṇḍukena); V 196,11* (assamassa ca sā dvāre ~en’ assa kīḷati, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee wr bheṇḍuken’); VI 471,27´ (kīḷanaṭṭhāne kumāro rāja-dhītaraṃ ~aṃ pi pāsakaṃ pi āharāpeti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee wr bheṇḍukaṃ); Spk II 250,.12 (kukkutaṇḍaṃ … ~aṃ viya gahetvā khipantena vā paharantena vā na sakkā kīḷituṃ); Dhp-a III 364,.5 (tesaṃ mukhesu pañca-vaṇṇānaṃ suttānaṃ ~ā pakkhittā honti); Cp-a 246,.5; — ifc see citta- (sv citta2).

2geṇḍuka
m. (?) [?], a kind of plant;? Sp 620,.19 (na kevalaṃ ca pupphaguḷadāmam eva, piṭṭhamayadāmaṃ pi °-pupphadāmaṃ pi Kurundiyaṃ vuttaṃ, Be, Ce so; Se geṇḍu-; Ee wr bheṇḍuka-; Sp-ṭ [Be] II 372,.30 : °-khara-pattadāmānaṃ paṭikkhittattā celādīhi katadāmaṃ pi na vaṭṭati; Se geṇḍu-); — see also geṇḍu2.
kattar:
1katta(r)
m. [from karoti; S. kartṛ] (iic usually kattu1-, also kattāra-, katta-), 1. one who makes, creates, produces (+ acc. or gen.); one who acts, who does; Vin I 245,.17 (isayo mantānaṃ ~āro); II 79,.12 (sarasi tvaṃ Dabba evarūpaṃ ~ā yathāyaṃ bhikkhunī āhā ti; prob. rather absol. of karoti qv; cf Sp 581,.7 : ye pana katvā ti paṭhanti tesaṃ ujukam eva); D I 18,.8 (Brahmā … issaro ~ā nimmātā); M I 220,.20 (na dhūmaṃ ~ā hoti); A II 102,.15 (puggalo bhāsitā hoti no ~ā); IV 32,12* (gambhīraṃ ca kathaṃ ~ā); Ja I 378,25* (kicce samuppanne ~āraṃ nādhigacchati; 378,29´ : tassa kiccassa ~āraṃ nādhigacchati na labhati); Ap 461,.4 (~ā netā); Mil 25,.26 (kammānaṃ ~ā vā kāretā vā); As 272,.13 (koci ~ā vā kāretā vā n’ atthi); Sadd 516,.19 (karotī ti ~ā); — ifc see ādi- (sv ādi1), āvi-; — 2. (gr.t.t.) the agent of an action (ie the subject [nom.] of an active verb, the agent [instr.] of a passive verb); Ud-a 106,.21 (vo ti … ~ari sāmivacanaṃ etaṃ, tasmā tumhehī ti attho); Vv-a 97,.13 (~u-atthe hi idaṃ sāmivacanaṃ); Sadd 691,.7 (yo kurute yo vā jāyati so ~ā); 718,.18 (~ari paṭhamā tatiyā ca); 822,.23 (~uno); — ifc see kamma-; — for kattā in Ce, Ee at Ja VI 213,20* (mantā ime attavadhāya kattā; Be, Se katā, unmetrical; 216,20´ : imehi brāhmaṇehi attavadhāya mantā katā) None L. Alsdorf, 1977, p. 54, fn 70, would read katto qv; —      (kattu)-kamma,   n., (gr.t.t.) agent and patient; the second agent of a causative verb; Sadd 692,.32 (puriso purisaṃ kammaṃ kāreti icc ādisu pana āṇattapurisādayo ~aṃ nāma, kattā ca so kammaṃ cā ti atthena); —       (kattu)-kāraka,   n., (gr.t.t.) the relation (to the action) as an agent; the classification of being an agent; a verbal form related principally to the agent, ie the active voice; Bv-a 25,.26 (~e buddhasaddasiddhi daṭṭhabbā); 204,.31 (tidivorohane ti saggalokato otarante ~e daṭṭhabbo, kārakavipallāsena vuttaṃ); Sadd 10,.28 (~aṃ); 691,.26 (abhinipphādanalakkhaṇaṃ ~aṃ); 859,.30 (~e kitpaccayo hoti); —       (kattu)-niddesa,        (kattāra)-niddesa,   m., (gr.t.t.) specification, indication of the agent; Ps I 5,.19 (evaṃ me sutaṃ … me ti kattāraniddeso) = Spk I 7,.1 (kattu-) = Ud-a 13,.33 (kattāra-) = It-a I 24,.26 (kattu-); Sadd 668,.26 (kattāraniddeso, kvacī ti kiṃ … kattuniddeso); —        (kattu)-pada,   n., (gr.t.t.) an active verbal form; Sadd 486,.4 (hanantī ti padaṃ ~aṃ); —             None,   m., 1. one who does not act; Ja III 26,27* (akataññuṃ ~āraṃ; 27,4´ : ~āran ti sayaṃ kiñci akarontaṃ); — 2. (gr.t.t.) not the agent of an action; Sadd 708,.21; — see also ekakattuka sv eka.

2katta(r)
m. [prob. = katta(r)1, but perhaps alternative form of khatta(r)1 qv] (sg.voc. katte; iic kattu2), attendant; steward; chamberlain; Ja V 220,24* (adūsiyaṃ ce Ahipāraka tvaṃ cajāse ~e ahitāya ty assa; 225,6´ : ~e ti tam eva aparena nāmena ālapati, so hi rañño hitaṃ karoti tasmā ~ā ti vuccati); VI 259,24* (pucchāma ~āram anomapaññaṃ; 259,.28 ´: ~āran ti kattabbayuttakānaṃ kārakaṃ); 268,6* (yadi te sūto Vidhuro nāma ~ā); 491,.26 (~āraṃ āmantetvā tassa santikaṃ pesesi); 492,2* (uṭṭhehi ~e); Sadd 670,.23 (uṭṭhehi ~e, ehi khatte, vā ti kiṃ, bho ~a, he khatta); 678,.25 (khattā ti c’ ettha sabbakammiko amacco, ~ā ti ca khattā ca ubhayaṃ p’ etaṃ anatthantaraṃ); —      (kattu)-seṭṭha,   m (fn)., best of stewards, most excellent steward; Ja VI 306,22* (Kurunaṃ ~o, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce katta-).
pokkhara:
1pokkhara
m.n. [S. puṣkara, n.], 1. a lotus; Abh 685; 827 (~aṃ padume); Dhp 336 (sokā tamhā papatanti udabindu va ~ā); Sn 392 (etesu dhammesu anūpalitto bhikkhu yathā ~e vāribindu); 812 (udabindu yathā pi ~e … na limpati; Nidd I 135,.23 : ~aṃ vuccati padumapattaṃ); — 2. the hollow body of a drum or vīṇā; (cf A.K. Coomaraswamy, 1930b, p. 250: ‘sounding board of a vīṇā, made of stretched skin’); Abh 138 (~o doṇi vīṇāya); 827; Vv 64:19 (vīṇā yathā pokkharapattabāhuhi; Vv-a 281,.17 : vīṇā samma-d-eva yojitehi doṇipattabāhudaṇḍehi); Sv 699,.30 (tassā [vīṇāya] kira sovaṇṇamayaṃ ~aṃ); Dhp-a I 215,.10 (tassā [vīṇāya] ~e ekaṃ chiddaṃ atthi); — ifc see eka-, tuccha-, bheri-; — 3. the tip of an elephant’s trunk; Abh 365 (karaggaṃ ~aṃ); 827; — 4. the body; water; Abh 827 (~aṃ … dehe … salile); Sv 282,.3 (porāṇā pan’ āhu ~an ti sarīraṃ vadanti) = Ps III 418,.9; —      °-ṭṭha, mfn., (what is) on a lotus, part of a lotus; Vin I 215,.18 (anujānāmi bhikkhave vanaṭṭhaṃ ~aṃ bhuttāvinā … paribhuñjitun ti; Sp 1093,.13 : ~an ti … paduminigacche ca jātaṃ); —       °-pattaka, m. [pokkhara + pattaka1], a lotus-leaf;? Ap 311,.15; —       °-vassa, n., a ‘lotus’ shower; Ja I 88,.32; VI 586,.32 (~aṃ vassāpesi ye tattha temitukāmā te tementi atemitukāmānaṃ upari ekabinduṃ pi na saṇṭhāti, padumapattato udakaṃ viya vinivattitvā gacchati); Dhp-a III 440,.16 (mahāmegho uṭṭhahitvā ~aṃ vassi); Th-a II 32,.10; —       °-sātaka, m. [cf S. puṣkarasāda], a kind of bird; Abh 626; D III 202,2*; Ja VI 539,9* (koṭṭhā ~ā); Sv 968,.3 (~ā nāma sakuṇā); Pj II 359,.1; —     supokkhara, mfn., with an excellent body; Bv-a 79,27* (cammanaddhā ~ā dundubhiyo ca vīṇā).

2pokkhara
n. [cf S. puṣkala], loveliness; excellence; Abh 827 (~aṃ … sundaratte); —      °-tā, f. [BHS puṣkaratā, puṣkalatā], excellence; Sv 282,.1 foll. (~ā vuccati sundarabhāvo, vaṇṇassa ~ā vaṇṇapokkharatā, tāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya vaṇṇasampattiyā yutto ti attho, porāṇā pan’ āhu pokkharan ti sarīraṃ vadanti … tesaṃ matena vaṇṇaṃ ca pokkharaṃ ca vaṇṇapokkharāni tesaṃ bhāvo vaṇṇapokkharatā) = Ps III 418,.7 foll.; — ifc see vaṇṇa-.
udicca:
1udicca
mfn. [cf S. udīcya], (northern; of northern descent, ie) of noble birth, high-born; Th 889 (brahmajacco pure āsiṃ ~o ubhato ahuṃ; Th-a III 64,.3 : ~o ubhato ti mātito ca pitito ca ubhato udito saṃsuddhagahaṇiko); Mil 236,.6 (abhijātaṃ ~aṃ jātivantaṃ … brāhmaṇaṃ); Th-a II 180,.29 (ahaṃ ~e brāhmaṇakule nibbatto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee uditodite); —      °-brāhmaṇa,   m., a high-born brahman; Ja II 83,.1; Th-a I 187,.17.
abhabba:
2bhabba
bhavya mfn. 1. [BHS bhavya] (i) able (to), capable (of); competent; fit for, with the potential for; (usually + dat. or inf.); Abh 1071 (~aṃ yogge); Vin I 17,.18 (~o nu kho Yaso gahapati hīnāyāvattitvā kāme paribhuñjtuṃ seyyathā pi pubbe agārikabhūto ti); II 254,.29 (~o nu kho bhante mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye … pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalaṃ vā … arahattaṃ vā sacchikātun ti); V 117,.16 (dve puggalā ~ā āpattiṃ āpajjituṃ bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca); M I 104,.1 foll. (bhikkhu … ~o sambodhāya ~o anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya); 222,.20 (ekādasahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako ~o gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ) ≠ A V 350,.25; S II 196,.1 (ātāpī ca kho ottāpī ~o sambodhāya ~o nibbānāya); A III 75,13* (nāhaṃ ~o etarahi kāmāni paṭisevituṃ); V 147,.9 (tayo … dhamme pahāya ~o jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātuṃ); Ud 49,.2 (ko nu kho idha ~o dhammaṃ viññātun ti; Ud-a 281,.8 foll.: maggaphaladhammaṃ adhigantuṃ samattho); It 106,19* (~ā te antakiriyāya); It-a I 106,.10 (°-taṃ dassento); — (ii) fit for, capable of, with the potential for, spiritual progress; Vibh 342,.1 (katame te sattā ~ā); Mil 167,.11 (ye te sattā ~ā te dhammāmatena bujjhanti ye pana te sattā abhabbā te dhammāmatena haññanti patanti); Vism 116,.13 (thero ~ā vat’ ime bhikkhū ti kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathesi); Nidd-a I 298,.26 foll. (ariyāya jātiyā bhavanti jāyantī ti ~ā, vattamānasamīpe vattamānavacanaṃ, bhavissanti jāyissanti vā ti ~ā … ye ariyamaggapaṭivedhassa anucchavikā upanissayasampannā te ~ā, vuttapaṭipakkhā abhabbā); — 2. [cf S. bhavya, bhāvya], about to be, likely to be, future; just existing, developing; what ought to be, proper, good; see R.M.L. Gethin, 2015; Abh 1071 (~aṃ … bhāvini); M III 215,.17 foll. (atthi kammaṃ ~aṃ c’ eva bhabbābhāsaṃ ca, atthi kammaṃ ~aṃ abhabbābhāsan ti; Ps V 20,.5 foll.; Ps-ṭ [Be] IV 380,.27 : bhavati vaḍḍhati etenā ti ~aṃ, vaḍḍhinimittaṃ); Ja V 325,10´ (bhavyāni ca taruṇadevatāni); VI 155,7´ (vaḍḍhitvā ṭhitā sattasaṅkhātā bhūtā ca idāni vaḍḍhanakasattasaṅkhātāni bhavyāni ca); Sv 112,.4 foll. (ahaṃ pitā bhūtānaṃ ca bhavyānaṃ cā ti … aṇḍajajalābujā sattā anto aṇḍakose … bhavyā nāma bahi nikkhantakālato paṭṭhāya bhūtā nāma); Sadd 847,.25 (bhavitabbo ~o bhavitabbaṃ ~aṃ); — ifc see bhūta- (sv bhavati); — bhavyaṃ in Ee at A II 44,4* is prob. wr; Be habyaṃ; Ce hutaṃ; Se huññaṃ; —      °’-āpattika, mfn., capable of committing an offence; Vin V 115,.22; Sp 1320,.26 (sāvakā ~ā nāma); —       ° âbhabbakā, m.f.pl., (those) who are capable and not capable (of progress); Bv-a 91,.35; —       °-rūpa, mfn., [cf S. bhavyarūpa], having a good or suitable appearance; seeming very capable; A I 189,.11 (mā anussavena … mā ~-tāya, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhavya-; Mp II 305,.27 foll.: ayaṃ bhikkhu ~o, imassa kathaṃ gahetuṃ yuttan ti pi mā gaṇhittha); Ud 79,24* (mohasambandhano loko ~o va dissati; cf Ud-a 386,.5 : yo idha sattaloko ~o va hetusampanno viya hutvā dissati) quoted Nett 62,.8 (62,.13 : viparītapaññatti lokassa); Sp 967,.24 (~o hoti sahetuko ñāto yasassī kulaputto); Spk I 298,.23 (tasmiṃ pana attabhāve maggaphalānaṃ ~ā puggalā); —     abhabba, mfn., 1. not able, not capable; not fit for; not capable of spiritual progress; Vin I 17,.6; V 117,.15 (dve puggalā ~ā āpattiṃ āpajjituṃ buddhā ca paccekabuddhā ca); D III 13,.23 (~o kho … acelo Pāṭikaputto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya … mama sammukhībhāvaṃ āgantuṃ); 133,.14 foll. (~o āvuso khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ); M I 464,.29 (tālo matthakacchinno ~o puna virūḷhiyā); S III 27,.2 (rūpaṃ … appajahaṃ ~o dukkhakkhayāya); Dhp 32 (~o parihānaya); It 117,20* (~o tādiso bhikkhu phuṭṭhuṃ sambodhim uttamaṃ); Sn 232 (~-tā diṭṭhapadassa vuttā); Ja VI 70,.1 (~o bhavissāmi kiṃ me pabbajjāya); Vibh 341,.37 (katame te sattā ~ā); Vism 54,.16 (~o visesādhigame); 388,.6 (atha naṃ thero ~o tvaṃ sāsane ti vihārato nīhari); Sp 1209,.15 (~o c’ esa puttapaṭilābhassa); Sv 739,.23 (~-ttā); — ~’-āpattika, mfn., not capable of committing an offence; Vin V 115,.22; Sp 1320,.27 (buddhā ca paccekabuddhā ca ~’-āpattikā nāma); — ~’-uppattika, mfn., not capable of arising (again); Ja II 327,10´ (taṃ purisaṃ … puna tāya sampattiyā ~’-uppattikaṃ kurumānā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee abhāvuppattiṃ); Nidd I 53,.28 (eso gedho pahīno … ~-uppattiko; Nidd-a I 171,.4 foll.: puna uppajjituṃ abhabbo); Dhp-a I 283,.3; — 2. not proper, not good; M III 215,.15 foll. (atthi kammaṃ ~aṃ abhabbābhāsaṃ atthi kammaṃ abhabbaṃ bhabbābhāsaṃ).
abhaṇana:
bhaṇana
n. [from bhaṇati1], speaking; saying; Sp 256,.2 (paṇḍitassāpi sahasāvasena aññaṃ ~aṃ); 1202,.15 (sarabhaññan ti sarena ~aṃ); Dhp-a IV 93,.8 (mantabhāṇī ti mantā vuccati paññā, tāya pana °-sīlo); Pj II 179,.16 (na hi te iṇaṃ atthi, mayā gahitan ti ko sakkhī ti evaṃ ~ena ghare vasanto pi palāyati); Nidd-a I 21,.2 (punappunaṃ ~am eva daḷhīkammaṃ nāma); — ifc see piya- (sv piya1); —    abhaṇana, n., not speaking; not saying; Ja V 423,11´ (evarūpassa vacanassa ~’-atthāya, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ābhaṇanatthāya).
abhinivutthapubba:
abhinivuttha
abhinivuṭṭha mfn. [pp of *abhi + nivasati; cf BHS abhinivasati], having lived in; —      °-pubba,   mfn., having previously lived in; D III 111,.10 (yasmiṃ yasmiṃ attabhāve ~o hoti, Ce, Se so; Be abhinivuṭṭha-; Ee ~aṃ, prob. wr).
abhipūjana:
abhipūjana
n. [from abhipūjeti], reverencing; paying honour; Th-a II 252,.18 (dhamme apaciti yathābhūtan ti ariyadhamme yāthāvato apacāyanaṃ ādarena ~aṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ariyadhammassa).
accādānaṭṭhānanti:
accādānaṭṭhānan ti
in Be, Se at Thī-a 63,.24 is prob. wr for accādhānaṭṭhānan ti (Ce, Ee so).
adhivāsī:
adhivāsi(n)
mfn. [S. adhivāsin], inhabiting, settled in; Sv 1,22* (therānaṃ … mahāvihārādhivasīnaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se mahāvihāre nivāsīnaṃ).
aggaḷaṭṭhapana:
aggala, aggaḷa
m.n. [S. argala; BHS argaḍa], 1. a bolt or bar for fastening a door (or window); the door-panel or door; Vin I 248,.2 (ālindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā ~aṃ ākoṭehi vivarissati te bhagavā dvāraṃ) = D I 89,.31 (Sv 252,.24 : ~an ti kavāṭaṃ); A IV 359,.1 (~aṃ ākoṭesi); Ja V 293,.20 (sā dvāraṃ addhavivaṭaṃ katvā ekaṃ hatthaṃ kavāṭe laggetvā ekena ~aṃ uppīḷetvā); VI 276,3* (esikā parikhāyo ca palikhaṃ ~āni ca … passa; 276,8´ : ~ānī ti nagaradvārakavāṭāni); 444,10* (ummaggadvāraṃ vivariṃsu yantayutte ca ~e; 444,11´ : sūcighaṭikasampannāni dvārakavāṭāni); Th-a II 220,.30 (~aṃ vuccati avijjā nibbānapurappavesanivāraṇato); Ap-a 106,.21 (sandhikavāṭehi ca ~ehi ca cittitā); — ifc see citr’-, phassit’-, phussit’-; — 2. a patch; Vin I 290,.2 (ayaṃ ca me antaravāsako chiddo, yannūnāhaṃ ~aṃ acchupeyyaṃ, samantato dupattaṃ bhavissati majjhe ekacciyan ti; Sp 1128,.17 : ~aṃ acchupeyyan ti chinnaṭṭhāne pilotikakhaṇḍaṃ ṭhapeyyaṃ); Ja VI 71,.8 (tehi paribhuttaṃ jiṇṇapilotikaṃ ~aṃ datvā rañjitvā sayaṃ paribhuñjati); Sp 647,.21 (dubbalaṭṭhāne paṭhamaṃ ~aṃ datvā); Ud-a 292,.2 (~ānaṃ anekavaṇṇabhāvena); Vin-vn 569 (~aṃ datvā); —       ° ânuppādana -    in Ee at Ps IV 157,.18 is prob. wr; Be, Ce, Se aggaḷaṭṭhānuppādana-; —         °-ṭṭhapana,   n., the placing or fixing of a door-bolt or door-panel; Vin IV 47,.23 (~āya; 47,.31 : ~āyā ti dvāraṭṭhapanāya; Sp 783,.26 : ~āyā ti sakavāṭakadvārabandhaṭṭhapanāya, sakavāṭakassa dvārabandhassa niccalabhāvatthāyā ti attho); Vin-vn 1105 (~āya tu bhikkhunā limpitabbaṃ); —         °-tthambha,   m., the post to which the bolt is fastened; Abh 217 (kapisīso ’ggaḷatthambho); Sp 1207,.20; —         °-tthambhaka,   m., id.; Pj I 54,.9 (dvinnaṃ vātapānakavāṭakānaṃ majjhe ṭhito ~o); —         °-dāna,   n., the putting on of a patch; Ja I 8,.31 (jiṇṇassa hi tunnaṃ vā ~aṃ vā kātabbaṃ hoti); Spk II 170,.8; —         °-pāsaka,   m., [aggala + pāsaka1; AMg aggalapāsaga, BHS argalapāśa] the socket or post which receives or holds the bolt; Sp 1207,.24 (kapisīsakaṃ nāma dvārabāhaṃ vijjhitvā tattha pavesito ~o vuccati, sūcikā ti tattha majjhe chiddaṃ katvā pavesitā); —         °-phalaka,   n., the panel of a door; M III 95,.23 (puriso lahukaṃ suttaguḷaṃ sabbasāramaye ~e pakkhipeyya; Ps IV 145,.23 : ~an ti kavāṭaṃ); —         °-vaṭṭi,   f., the post to which the bolt is fastened; Vin II 120,.17 (anujānāmi bhikkhave kavāṭaṃ … ~iṃ …; Sp 1207,.20 : ~i nāma dvārabāhāya samappamāṇo yeva aggaḷatthambho vuccati, yattha tīni cattāri chiddāni katvā sūciyo denti); —         °-sūci,   f., a bolt-pin, a bolt; M I 126,.3 (~iṃ gahetvā sīse pahāraṃ adāsi); Spk I 48,.7 (~i viya vinivijjhitvā gato); Ud-a 298,.7 (~iṃ uparighaṭikaṃ ca ādahitvā suṭṭhutaraṃ kavāṭaṃ thaketvā ti attho); —       niraggala,    niraggaḷa,   mfn. and n., 1. (mfn.) [S. nirargala], unbarred, unimpeded; free; M I 139,.16 foll. (ayaṃ vuccati … bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho iti pi … ~o iti pi … bhikkhuno pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni honti … evaṃ … bhikkhu ~o hoti; Ps II 116,.7 : etāni hi kavātaṃ viya nagaradvāraṃ cittaṃ pidahitvā ṭhitattā aggaḷā ti vuccanti … tesaṃ … bhinnattā ~o ti vutto) = A III 84,.14 foll. m. (and n.) [S., BHS dharma], dhamma denotes (an interpretation of) the essential nature and reality of existence and experience, the way things are: it is descriptive and prescriptive; it denotes also an essential attribute of men or animals; a quality or characteristic; Abh 784 (~o sabhāve pariyattipaññāñāyesu saccappakatīsu puññe ñeyye guṇācārasamādhisū pi nissattatāpattisu kāraṇādo); see also Sv 99,.3 foll., Ps I 17,.16 foll., It-a I 37,.20 foll., Paṭis-a 18,.1 foll., Bv-a 13,.4 foll., As 38,.23 foll. and Sadd 560,.25 foll.; — for Buddhists dhamma is used to denote an interlocking and interdependent assembly of concepts: the true nature of the world of experience, how that world works, and the way to transcend it, as understood by the Buddha; the progressive stages of understanding and nibbāna ; the behaviour, the practice, required to achieve understanding of the way the world of experience works, ie the way to reach arhatship, nibbāna ; the understanding and practice taught by the Buddha, the substance of his teaching, the texts of the Canon, especially the Suttapiṭaka ; all constituents of the world of experience, physical and mental, external and internal, progressively more and more minutely analysed; all constituents of prescribed practice, appropriate and beneficial actions; prescriptions for the members of the saṅgha ; — for people generally dhamma is an interpretation of the essential nature of existence and experience; the way one should act, depending on who one is, to maintain the way things are and should be; duty; right; justice; normative and beneficial actions; — 1. (i) how the world of experience works, the processes by which it works and is explained (especially as formulated in cattāri ariyasaccāni and paṭiccasamuppāda ), and the possibility and way of transcending it, as understood by the Buddha and taught by him (so that knowledge and understanding of it might bring enlightenment, arhatship, to others); Vin I 2,3* (yadā have pātubhavanti ~ā ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa ath’ assa kaṅkhā vapayanti sabbā yato pajānāti sahetudhammaṃ; Sp 954,.19 foll. : pātubhavantī ti uppajjanti ~ā ti anulomapaccayākārapaṭivedhasādhakā bodhipakkhiyadhammā, atha vā pātubhavantī ti pakāsenti abhisamayavasena vyattā pākaṭā honti, ~ā ti caturāriyasaccadhammā); 11,.2 (idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu ~esu cakkhuṃ udapādi); 12,.24 (ehi bhikkhū ti bhagavā avoca svākkhāto ~o cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā ti); 15,.31 (idaṃ kho Yasa anupaddutaṃ idaṃ anupassaṭṭhaṃ ehi Yasa nisīda ~aṃ te desessāmī ti); 40,.19 foll.
